description: Fetch reviews for a single product by its Alza code: the aggregate rating and review count plus up to `limit` individual reviews (author as Alza displays it, date, rating, body, pros/cons) from Alza's reviews API, newest first. `reviewCount` is the product page's aggregate; the reviews list can contain more items than it, apparently because the API also returns reviews from other storefronts (Slovak-language reviews have been seen; the API has no market field to confirm it) — the response text says so when that happens. Use after `get_product` when the user wants real-world feedback before deciding. If the reviews API is unavailable you receive the aggregate only (empty `reviews` array) — in that case rely on the rating/count. Do not use for the aggregate rating alone when you already have it from `search_products`/`get_product`. Read-only.

code.description: Alza product code, e.g. 'WEXOA002B0'. Same as the `code` from `search_products`.

limit.description: Maximum number of individual reviews to include. Default 10, max 50.

name: get_product_reviews
title: Get product reviews
